app.name: Monitoring Assist
app.description: Select entities and generate DQL, SLOs, anomaly detectors and segments.

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: List and search monitored entities in Grail

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Required by toSmartscapeId() and getNodeName(), used by the service SLI templates

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Preview log-based DQL for the selected entities

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Preview span-based DQL for the selected entities

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Preview metric timeseries for the selected entities

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Preview event-based DQL for the selected entities

scopes.name: settings:schemas:read
scopes.comment: Resolve the anomaly detector settings schema

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:write
scopes.comment: Create segments from the current entity selection

scopes.name: slo:slos:read
scopes.comment: List existing service-level objectives (Grail SLO service)

scopes.name: slo:slos:write
scopes.comment: Create service-level objectives from the current entity selection
